items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: I got a telegram from Benny Golson. And he said he wanted me to come to New York and join the Jazztet... you got the job... Art and Benny and myself.

ctx.x: When you got through the Jazz Brothers time, other things opened up for you. Betty Carter a few years later?

No, what happened is we went to the Five Spot and played with the Brothers, and then I came back to Rochester and we went back into The Pythod. And I got a telegram from Benny Golson. And he said he wanted me to come to New York and join the Jazztet. And Tootie Heath was the drummer with the ‘tet then, and Tootie was leaving. So, great, I says, that’s fantastic. So it was about a week or so before I had to join them. And so they threw me a big party and everything at The Pythod. And I told everybody I was going…
Well that wasn’t the normal way of doing things was it?
